title: Crit Charge Helper
description: Displays corner indicators on your crosshair when your attack is fully charged and ready to perform a critical hit.
body: This mod adds a dynamic visual indicator to your crosshair that lets you know exactly when your attack is fully charged and ready to perform a critical hit. Once your attack reaches 100% charge, small corner markers appear around your crosshair, giving you a clear and instant signal without needing to look away from the center of the screen. This helps you improve your timing, land more consistent critical hits, and perform better in both PvP and PvE combat situations. The indicator is designed to be simple, clean, and non-intrusive, so it blends naturally with your gameplay while still providing useful feedback. Whether you're fighting mobs or other players, having precise visual timing can make a big difference in your overall performance. Additionally, the mod includes customization options to match your personal preferences. By pressing the K key, you can easily adjust the color and size of the crosshair corners. This allows you to create a style that fits your UI setup, whether you prefer something subtle or more eye-catching. Overall, this is a lightweight and practical tool for players who want better control and awareness during combat.
